facts.fact: The Namibia Statistics Agency says births are notified electronically from health facilities (e-birth notification launched 2017) and captured on the National Population Register System, but some registration offices lack computers and connectivity and transfer paper records to head office.
The Namibia Statistics Agency says the e-death notification system was launched in 2018 and deaths are captured on the National Population Register System, with 2021 death completeness at 97.6%.
The Namibia Statistics Agency reports birth registration completeness of 99.2% in 2018 falling to 62.0% in 2021 (under-five completeness 19.9%), a national rate not tied to the digital system.
